name: Serial Plotter sine and triangle
desc: This example demonstrates how to use the Arduino Serial Plotter to visualize a sine wave and a triangle wave. The frequency of the waves can be controlled using a potentiometer connected to analog pin A0. The sine wave is generated using the `sin()` function, while the triangle wave is calculated based on the phase of the wave. The output values are scaled to fit within the range of 0 to 1023, which corresponds to the range of an analog input on the Arduino.
